Variants.Content: Golden Castle is located in the interior of the North and belongs to the feudal network of the North under the jurisdiction of Winterfell. It is a limited-scale local castle that is responsible for protecting surrounding villages, collecting grain taxes, and maintaining roads; in the long winter, the granary and passable snow roads are more important than the name of the castle.

Entry Goldgrass Local families also rely on firewood, hunting grounds, peat, salt fish, and granaries to survive the long winter; if any road, well, spring, or wharf fails, the price will fall on them first.

Entry Goldgrass If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

The craftsmen use their hands to measure the stone walls, wooden beams, iron doors, tombs, and seams left by generations of repairs. The priests use rituals to continue the cemeteries left by the old gods, weirwood trees, and ancestors. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Goldgrass They care about firewood, hunting grounds, peat, salt fish, and granaries that can survive the long winter. They also care about whether seeds are left after the grain collection and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, they see whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
